title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
authors: E. Frantar, S. Ashkboos, T. Hoefler, D. Alistarh
before: 8-bit quantization worked; 4-bit lost too much accuracy to be usable.
problem: Even 8-bit weights leave the largest models out of reach of a single GPU.
breakthrough: One-shot second-order weight rounding that holds accuracy at 3 to 4 bits, in a few GPU hours.
why: 4-bit is what makes a 70B model fit on consumer hardware. This is why local inference is possible at all.
next: AWQ traded a different accuracy-speed point; GGUF packaged quantized weights for llama.cpp.
inherits: The 4-bit quantized checkpoint as the standard local format.
